name: Laoshan Cola
verdict: Laoshan Cola is a brand of Qingdao Beverage Group, an enterprise wholly owned by the Qingdao municipal SASAC; new front sponsor of Qingdao Hainiu for the 2026 CSL season.

why.text: Laoshan Cola is a brand of Qingdao Beverage Group, which is wholly owned by the Qingdao municipal state-assets commission. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind Laoshan Cola is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.
